Clinton is to be complimented on securing a place in a club championship at his first attempt. The sealed handicap held in conjunction was deservedly won by Clinton, while Dick Tobin secured second place with Stan Eeles and Harry Shields dead-heating for third prize.

Dick Tobin lead the field out at a fair pace, then bunched together were Carter, Bill Lucas, Clinton, Abberton, Eales, Blowfield, Penny, with Footer and Morrell a little behind, and Len Herbert at the rear.

Going back that far reminds me of that exceptional performance in 1945 when with Burfitt (1), Main (2), Pearson (3) and Eeles (13) Belgrave 'A' won with 19 points, to be followed by Tobin (5), Clinton (7), Smart (17) and Jarlett (26) who brought home Belgrave 'B' in second place.
